source_note: 由一个级数收敛证明另一个有关级数的收敛问题
english_source_note: Deducing One Series Convergence from Another
callout_id: 由一个级数收敛证明另一个有关级数的收敛问题#1
statement_en: Let $a_n>0$ be a sequence, and suppose the series $\sum_{n\geq 1} a_n$ converges. Prove that the series $\sum_{n\geq 1} a_n^{\frac{n}{n+1}}$ also converges.
key_techniques: split the index set into cases
callout_body: 序列$a_n>0$，级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}a_n$收敛，证明级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}a_n^{\frac{n}{n+1}}$也收敛。
